Business websites that load fast, read clearly, and are easy to update

We design and build websites for small businesses and organizations, from a focused landing page to a full multi-page site you can edit yourself.

Get a website quoteSee our work

What we build

Every site is designed for your audience and written in clean, standards-based code, so it stays fast and maintainable.

Custom business websites

Multi-page sites for services, products, team, and contact, designed around your brand.

Landing pages

A single focused page for a launch, campaign, or event, built to move visitors to one action.

Website redesign

A modern rebuild of an outdated site, keeping the content and search visibility that already work.

Content management

Where you need it, an editor so your team can change text, images, and events without code.

SEO foundations

Semantic structure, page titles, descriptions, and clean URLs so search engines can understand you.

Performance

Optimized images, lean code, and careful font loading for quick pages on mobile networks.

Accessibility

Keyboard navigation, readable contrast, and proper labels, targeting WCAG 2.2 AA.

Ongoing maintenance

Updates, backups, and changes after launch through a maintenance arrangement.

One site that works on every screen

Most visitors arrive on a phone. We design the small screen first, then expand the layout for tablets and desktops.

  • Layouts tested from 375px phones to 1920px monitors
  • Touch-friendly buttons and readable type without zooming
  • Navigation that adapts instead of shrinking

Screenshots show the ECAA community website, built by the Jemawe team.

Our website development process

Six stages, each with something for you to review. Nothing moves forward without your approval.

  1. Discovery call

    Goals, audience, examples you like, and what the site must do.

  2. Scope and quote

    A written page list, feature list, timeline, and price for approval.

  3. Content and structure

    Sitemap and page outlines; we help shape copy you supply.

  1. Design

    Home and key page designs on real content, revised with your feedback.

  2. Build and test

    Development, then testing on phones, tablets, desktops, and keyboards.

  3. Launch and handover

    Go live on your domain, with instructions for editing and next steps.

What helps us start quickly

You do not need everything on day one, but these speed things up.

  • Your logo and any brand colors or fonts you already use
  • A rough list of pages and the main thing visitors should do
  • Photos you own or have permission to use
  • Access to your domain registrar, or a plan to buy a domain
  • Two or three websites you like, and what you like about them

Start a website project

A few details are enough to begin. For a fuller brief, use the quote request.

For example: show our services, take event registrations, let customers find our hours.

This form is not connected yet

You can fill it in and we will check every field, but submissions are not sent anywhere until Jemawe connects a secure form service. Nothing you type is stored.

What we ask for, and why

  • Only what we need to reply and understand the request.
  • Never passwords, PINs, or payment details.
  • Replies are handled during business hours, not around the clock.

Website questions

How long does a website take?

It depends on the number of pages and how ready your content is. The written scope includes a timeline for your specific project before you commit.

Can I edit the website myself?

Yes, when it makes sense. We can add a content editor for the pages you update often, such as events or menus, and show you how to use it.

Do you write the content?

You know your business best, so you supply the core information. We help structure and edit it for the web, and can agree additional writing in the scope.

Who hosts the website?

We recommend a hosting option that suits your site and budget during planning. Hosting and domain fees are paid to the provider and listed separately from our work.
